strategy_roster.name: Hoop Master Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The breakout box around the latest close is approximated by a 20-bar range, so the armed buy-stop above the box becomes a fresh-range high and the box low is the long exit. The martingale lot doubling after losses, the 15-pip indent and the 25/70 pip stop-target are not expressible; no percent values are documented.

strategy_roster.name: ADX System
strategy_roster.notes: +DI/-DI are not available, so directional pressure is taken from the one-bar rate of change of the 14-bar high versus 14-bar low, and the documented ADX(14) rising condition is kept as the regime filter. TakeProfit 15 / StopLoss 100 / TrailingStop 20 are absolute price units, not percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: TTM Grid
strategy_roster.notes: This is a grid engine that keeps adding tickets on every grid level touch and explicitly has no exit, accumulating positions. Grid/martingale mechanics and the TTM state reset cannot be expressed as a single long signal, so it is marked non-trading.

strategy_roster.name: MA MACD BB BackTester
strategy_roster.notes: The docs expose MA, MACD and BB as mutually exclusive modes with no numeric defaults, so the roster resolves the selector to the Bollinger breakout variant with 20-period and 2.0 multiplier fallbacks and the long direction flag. The MA and MACD variants and the StartDate/EndDate window are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: EMA SAR Bulls Bears
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,3) > ema(close,34) and roc(ema(close,3),1) > 0 and (high - ema(close,13)) > 0 and roc(high - ema(close,13),1) < 0
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR is approximated by the EMA(3) slope against the candle extreme and Bulls Power by high minus EMA(13) with its documented falling slope, alongside the documented EMA(3)/EMA(34) trend test. The 09:00-17:00 window and the 400/2000 point targets are not expressible as percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: Turn Of Month
strategy_roster.notes: This is a calendar-seasonality system that buys N days before month end and exits M days into the new month, driven purely by the date index with no price-derived signal, and the DSL exposes no date or time fields. Marked non-trading.

strategy_roster.name: Patterns EA
strategy_roster.notes: The docs list 30 single/double/triple-bar formations with per-pattern enable and direction toggles but never enumerate the rules, so the roster keeps one representative long reversal candle (close crossing above open) with an SMA(20) filter. Equality-pip tolerance, the opened-mode logic and per-pattern order assignment are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Gartley 222
strategy_roster.notes: The 222 ratio geometry and pivot-based confirmation are replaced by an EMA(20) pullback-and-recovery proxy, with the documented PivotLength 5 encoded as the 5-bar arming window and Fib Tolerance 0.05 dropped. The documented 2% stop loss is used; the 1.27 fib extension target is a range ratio, not a percent field.

strategy_roster.name: IU Open Equal to High Low
strategy_roster.notes: The open-equals-low geometry is applied to any bar with a 0.1% equality tolerance because the DSL has no session/time fields to isolate the first candle of the day, and the long side (open at the low, close up) is traded. The prior-candle low becomes the structural exit; the RiskReward 2 target and stop are price distances, not percents.

strategy_roster.name: Non-Repainting Renko Emulation
strategy_roster.notes: Renko brick construction is approximated by a 3-bar price continuation in the EMA(10) direction, so an upward brick sequence enters long and a reversal closes it. The documented BrickSize 3 is a point offset that cannot be enforced without shifted brick levels, and no stops are documented.
